summary: Grayscale Ethereum Classic Trust filed an 8-K to announce a change in the benchmark index used for calculating its NAV and NAV per share, effective September 1, 2026. The Trust will switch from the CoinDesk Ethereum Classic Price Index to the CoinDesk Ethereum Classic Benchmark Extended Rate. This is an operational change to the valuation methodology, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, transactions, or corporate actions involved. The filing is routine and informational, with no impact on shareholders beyond a potential change in NAV calculation. What to watch would be any subsequent updates on the index transition or NAV impact.
